newsitem.title: GERMANY: Swap pig's stomach for soya, ex-Beatle tells Kohl.
newsitem.headline: Swap pig's stomach for soya, ex-Beatle tells Kohl.

text.p: Germany's food-loving Chancellor Helmut Kohl will soon be swapping his beloved stuffed pig's stomach for soya and tofu if a pressure group supported by Paul McCartney gets its way.
People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA) said on Wednesday it planned to hand a vegetarian cookbook autographed by the former Beatle into Kohl's chancellery on Thursday.
"First of all it might help him to lose weight and it also might help broaden his diet and give him some more healthy nourishment," a spokeswoman for the group said.

The portly chancellor is famous for his large appetite and his fondness for pig's stomach -- a delicacy from his home region in southwestern Germany -- which was included in a recipe book he published together with his wife Hannelore last year.
McCartney, whose wife Linda has launched her own range of frozen vegetarian food, said Germany already had more than four million vegetarians and invited the Kohls to join them.

"Linda and I think PETA's new vegetarian cookbook makes the perfect complement to the Kohl cookbook," McCartney wrote in a dedication to the chancellor. "After all those heavy, meaty recipes, you may be ready to lighten up in the kitchen."

PETA said a woman dressed up as a pig would be among its activists handing over the book, which includes vegetarian recipes from celebrities such as film star Kim Basinger and former tennis ace Martina Navratilova.
